proposal.title: Restore the Lantern Lane evening light
proposal.materials: Preserve original visible stone and metal; hidden LED internals only
proposal.colour: Unchanged stone grey; no joinery changes
proposal.narrative: Repair the existing protected public evening lantern. Replace only failed hidden lighting components with LEDs. Preserve outward form, visible material, height, footprint and historic public evening-light function. No excavation or drainage changes.

proposal.title: Reopen the ceremonial stair for commuters
proposal.narrative: Repair the ceremonial stair with matching original stone within its existing height and footprint. Reopen the staircase for everyday commuter access rather than ceremonial occasions. No drainage changes or groundworks.

proposal.title: Freestanding garden reading pavilion
proposal.narrative: Place a freestanding timber reading pavilion on surface pads in the existing private garden. Removal requires no excavation and restores the former garden use. No frontage wall, canal silhouette change, foundations or drainage changes.

proposal.title: Temporary pavilion during nesting season
proposal.narrative: Install a temporary timber garden pavilion beside the canal in April. The exterior work is completely reversible without excavation and preserves garden use. We request the reversible-work exemption even though the environmental register may have habitat restrictions.

proposal.title: Repair a structure on an unregistered parcel
proposal.narrative: Repair a small existing garden structure at unchanged dimensions and use. We cannot supply authoritative parcel or heritage records. Please check whether the site is permitted under the construction code.

proposal.title: Emergency repair of a failed garden drain
proposal.materials: Matching existing drain pipe, buried in the existing trench
proposal.narrative: Emergency repair of an existing failed drain causing immediate flooding. Repair only the existing route and discharge point in the original trench; preserve drainage direction and existing discharge rights. No new permanent footprint or added capacity. The private garden use is unchanged.
